QuestInfo.name: [Arcana] Farewell, City of Nightmares
QuestInfo.0: The red fog covering Lachelein has not yet dissipated. It looks like it will be some time before the city is completely free.
QuestInfo.1: You follow a familiar sound and happen upon your old friend, the Flying Fish. Talk to #rFlying Fish#k in #b#m450003010##k to find out if you can move to the next area.
QuestInfo.2: It seems as though it will be some time before the red fog of Lachelein is completely lifted. You follow a familiar sound and happen upon your old friend, the Flying Fish. Riding on his back, you made your way out of Lachelein.

0.msg: #b(The red fog created by Lucid has not yet dissipated. It looks like it will be some time before the city is completely free.)#k

2.msg: #b(You should go follow the sound and see what it's coming from.)#k

0.msg: #b(It sounds like it's coming from the right, down the Lachelein canal.)#k
#b(You should wait a little bit. There's no need to hurry.)#k

yes.0: #b(You sit atop the Flying Fish, and it immediately begins to move down the canal.)#k

default.0: #b(It sounds like it's coming from the right, down the Lachelein canal. You should hurry and investigate.)#k
